content.title: Where to watch Alcaraz vs. Sinner Monte-Carlo Masters final today on free streams, TV
content.text: Carlos Alcaraz of Spain celebrates after winning a point over Cameron Norrie of Britain at the BNP Paribas Open tennis tournament Thursday, March 12, 2026, in Indian Wells, Calif. (AP Photo/Mark J. Terrill)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe world’s top two players go head to head Sunday in a Carlos Alcaraz versus Jannik Sinner at the Monte-Carlo Masters. The match is scheduled to start at 9 a.m. ET with TV coverage on Tennis Channel and streaming on-demand.How to watch: Live streams of the Alcaraz vs. Sinner match are available with offers from FuboTV (free trial), DirecTV (free trial) and SlingTV (low intro rate).This will be the 17th all-time meeting between Alcaraz and Sinner, the seven most recent of which have come in a tournament final. Alcaraz has won 10 of the previous 16 head-to-head meetings and is 7-2 over the past nine, but Sinner has the most recent victory in straight sets (7-6, 7-5) in the 2025 Nitto ATP Finals. In the case of Sunday’s final, the winner will also exit the weekend with the No. 1 world ranking. #1 Carlos Alcaraz vs. #2 Jannik SinnerMonte-Carlo Masters Tennis TournamentChampionship match at a glanceWhen: Sunday, April 12 at 9 a.m. ETWhere: Monte-Carlo Country Club, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, FranceTV channels: Tennis ChannelLive streams: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | Sling (low intro rate)Alcaraz is out to defend his 2025 Monte-Carlo masters title after defeating hometown favorite Valentin Vacherot (6-4, 6-4) in Saturday’s semifinal round. In his four matches to this point, Alcaraz has dropped just one set in the third round against Tomas Martin Etcheverry (6-1, 4-6, 6-3). The same is true of Sinner, who went three sets in the third round before handling No. 6 Felix Auger-Aliassime (6-3, 6-4) and No. 3 Alexander Zverev (6-1, 6-4) in the quarters and semis, respectively.
